Appendix 4 — Indices

The spell index is alphabetized by name; the letter after a name identifies its list: C for cleric, D for druid and M for magic-user. The same letters are used by the Spell compendium's folder keys. Tables and checklists are indexed by category in the Tables compendium; monsters and equipment are indexed alphabetically inside their category folders.
